items.raw_excerpt: The Convent of Christ in Tomar will reopen its renovated cloisters on 24 September, welcoming the public back with a nighttime visit to the Main Cloister, which will also allow visitors to see the new lighting in that space.
items.summary_en: The Convent of Christ in Tomar will open its restored cloisters again on 24 September. Visitors can walk through the Main Cloister at night and see the new lights there. The convent is one of the most visited old buildings in central Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 토마르의 크리스티 수도원이 복원한 회랑을 9월 24일 다시 공개한다. 밤에는 본 회랑을 걸어볼 수 있고 새로 설치한 조명도 볼 수 있다. 이 수도원은 포르투갈 중부에서 가장 많이 찾는 고대 건축물 중 하나다.
items.title_en: Convent of Christ in Tomar reopens its old cloisters
items.title_ko: 토마르 크리스티 수도원, 복원한 회랑을 다시 공개
items.title_original: Convent of Christ reopens cloisters to the public with nighttime visits

items.raw_excerpt: Germany's strict protections of personal freedom and privacy extend to the workplace, limiting employers' ability to interfere with office romances, but there are some rules to be aware of.
items.summary_en: Germany protects private life at work, so employers cannot punish staff for a romance at the office. But some rules still apply, such as not using work time or company property for the relationship.
items.summary_ko: 독일은 사내에서도 개인의 사생활을 보호해 사내 연애를 이유로 직원을 해고할 수 없습니다. 다만 업무 시간이나 회사 자원을 개인 관계에 사용하지 않는 등 지켜야 할 규칙이 있습니다.
items.title_en: Can You Be Fired in Germany for a Workplace Romance?
items.title_ko: 독일에서 사내 연애로 해고될 수 있나요
items.title_original: Can you be sacked in Germany for a workplace romance?

items.raw_excerpt: It's tax season in France, with payments due and 'taxe foncière' property tax bill being sent out. If you’re struggling to pay one or both of them, here's what you can do to get help.
items.summary_en: It is tax season in France. People who cannot pay their income tax or property tax can ask the tax office for help. They may get a payment plan, a delay, or a reduction.
items.summary_ko: 지금은 프랑스의 세금 시기라 income tax 납부와 재산세 고지서가 나가고 있다. 세금을 낼 수 없는 사람은 국세청에 도움을 신청할 수 있다. 분할 납부, 납부 유예, 감면 가운데 하나를 받을 수도 있다.
items.title_en: France: Help You Can Get If You Cannot Pay Your Tax Bills
items.title_ko: 프랑스, 세금을 못 낼 때 받을 수 있는 지원 정리
items.title_original: EXPLAINED: The help you can get in France if you're struggling to pay your tax bills

items.raw_excerpt: Japan has been starved of swimming success in recent times but with the Olympics two years away junk food-loving teenager Shin Ohashi has emerged as their next big hope. The 17-year-old, who stands just 169 cm, has posted the two fastest 200 meters breaststroke times in the world this year…
items.summary_en: Shin Ohashi is 17 years old and only 169 cm tall. This year he posted the two fastest 200 meters breaststroke times in the world. Japan hopes he will win a medal at the Olympics in two years.
items.summary_ko: 오하시 신은 17세이며 키가 169cm에 불과합니다. 올해 그는 세계에서 가장 빠른 200m 가슴질 기록 두 개를 세웠습니다. 일본은 2년 뒤 올림픽에서 그가 메달을 얻길 기대하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: A teen who loves junk food is Japan's next swimming hope
items.title_ko: Junk food 좋아하는 십대, 일본의 새로운 수영 기대주
items.title_original: Shin Ohashi: Junk food-loving teen and Japan's next big swimming hope

items.raw_excerpt: Supporters of John Amagoalik are helping him take the Nunavut government to court as a last resort to force the territory to pay his living expenses so he can spend his final days at home.
items.summary_en: John Amagoalik helped create the territory of Nunavut in northern Canada. Now he says the government owes him money for his living costs. His supporters want to take the Nunavut government to court. He hopes to spend his last days at home.
items.summary_ko: 존 아마고알릭은 캐나다 북부의 누나부트 지역을 만드는 데 도움을 준 인물입니다. 그는 이제 정부가 자신의 생활비 돈을 갚아야 한다고 말합니다. 지지자들은 누나부트 Drawings government를 법정으로 상대하려고 합니다. 그는 마지막 날을 고향에서 보내고 싶어합니다.
items.title_en: The Father of Nunavut has one fight left: to live in the land he helped build
items.title_ko: 누나부트의 아버지가 남은 한 번의 싸움: 자신이 만든 땅에서 살고 싶습니다
items.title_original: 'Father of Nunavut' has one more fight left: to live in the territory he helped create

items.raw_excerpt: In this week’s Sweden in Focus Extra, The Local's Mandy Pipher tells us about the bureaucratic nightmare surrounding her recent trip to Canada.
items.summary_en: The writer planned a short trip to Canada. Swedish border officials said she would likely be denied entry back to Sweden. She describes the long paperwork and waiting that made the trip stressful.
items.summary_ko: 필필은 캐나다로 짧은 여행을 다녀오기로 했습니다. 스웨덴 국경 당국에서 스웨덴으로 돌아올 수 없을 가능성이 크다고 통보받았습니다. 그녀는 그 여행을 번거롭게 만든 서류 절차와 긴 대기를 풀이합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Olivia Dews and Charlotte Casey have Freidriech's Ataxia, a debilitating neurological condition.
items.summary_en: Sisters Olivia Dews and Charlotte Casey both have Friedreich's ataxia, a nerve condition that slowly makes daily life harder. The sisters are going to Parliament to ask the NHS for better care. Their story shows what a long illness does to an ordinary family.
items.summary_ko: 올리비아 듀스와 샤를롯 케이시 자매는 신경계 질환인 프리드릭 운동장애증을 함께 앓고 있다. 두 자매는 NHS가 더 나은 치료를 제공하도록 청원하려고 의회로 찾아간다. 긴 병에 시달리는 평범한 한 가족의 이야기가 함께 담겨 있다.
items.title_en: Two sisters with a life-limiting condition take their NHS fight to Parliament
items.title_ko: 삶의 한계를 가로막는 질환을 앓는 두 자매, NHS 문제를 의회로 가져가다

items.raw_excerpt: Some employers are distributing N95 masks, issuing health reminders and preparing to adjust work arrangements if air quality worsens.
items.summary_en: Hazy air in Singapore is making many companies take extra care of outdoor workers. Some employers are giving out N95 masks and sending health reminders. They may change work schedules if the air gets worse.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르의 스모그 때문에 많은 회사가 야외 근로자를 챙기는 방법을 강화하고 있다. 일부 기업은 N95 마스크를 나눠주고 건강 유의사항을 알리고 있다. 공기가 더 나빠지면 근무 방식을 조정할 수 있다고 했다.

items.title_original: Haze in Singapore: Companies step up precautions for outdoor workers

items.raw_excerpt: As the government bans deep fried food in schools, a head teacher shares his healthy eating stance.
items.summary_en: The government has banned deep fried food in schools. One head teacher says his school serves pupils kilos of olives every week. He says this helps the children eat healthy food.

items.summary_en: Kerry players Ryan O'Donoghue and Jack Carney are nominated for the PwC GAA Footballer of the Year award. They face Mayo's David Clifford, who is also in the running. The winner of the award will be announced soon.

items.raw_excerpt: If you've lived in or visited Spain in autumn or winter you may have noticed that Spaniards often dress according to the time of year and not how hot or cold it is. We asked our readers to share their stories as we find out why this could be.
items.summary_en: In Spain, people often wear clothes that match the season instead of the actual temperature. Readers shared their own stories about this habit. The reason behind it is still a puzzle.
items.summary_ko: 스페인에서는 기온이 아니라 계절에 맞춰 옷을 차리는 경우가 많다. 독자들은 이런 습관에 대한 자신의 이야기를 들려주었다. 그 이유를 알아보는 중이지만 여전히 풀리지 않은 수수께끼다.
items.title_en: Why Spaniards dress for the season, not the weather

items.summary_en: Ani Gülgün-Mayr has lived in Austria for more than 50 years. She says she was refused citizenship because of small traffic fines. The Local asked the ORF presenter how she feels about the decision.

items.raw_excerpt: A Victorian residential services provider is pushing for "more structured support mechanisms" for vulnerable people during prolonged power outages as thousands in Mildura head towards a third day without electricity.
items.summary_en: A power outage in Mildura, Australia has left thousands of people without electricity for close to three days. A local services group says vulnerable people need more organised help during long outages. The company wants stronger support systems for people who need extra care.
